# Specialist method coverage

Use this reference to interpret the source ledger's specialist dispositions. It records fresh-worded methods and boundaries; it does not activate another skill or run its lifecycle. Runtime instructions remain in the main intake references. The coverage-only augmentation performed no tests, evaluations, installations, workflow execution or Firecrawl calls.

## Superpowers

The historical 6.3.0 brainstorming copy distinguishes a cheap feasibility probe, a bounded change to an existing flow, and architectural discovery. Preserve the proportionality and single dependent-question sequence. Its committed design documents, staged approvals and transition to implementation planning belong to its lifecycle.

The 6.4.2 copy adds an explicit correction step: recover outcome, beneficiary and success from the request and available context; reflect statements separately from assumptions; invite and incorporate corrections. Already supplied purpose should not be asked again. It also distinguishes approval of scope, a written specification and an implementation plan. One does not imply another. The current catalog exposes 6.4.2; the prior audit's 6.3.0 activation observation is historical.

Both visual-companion references choose the visual surface per question. Conceptual choices can remain textual. Shared intake does not start a browser server, require mockups, commit design files or inherit per-request approval ceremonies.

## Automation

Cursor automate first disambiguates the product surface: generic automation does not establish Cursor Automation intent. Its transferable frame is trigger, action and intended outcome, using discovered integration candidates before asking about facts. It distinguishes trigger destination from action destination, unresolved picker values from explicit editor deferral, and missing capability from unauthenticated capability. Cursor editor availability/auth gates and creation-only backend restrictions remain specialist instructions.

Design-control-loop adds desired property, measurement, next-increment selection, intervention, disturbances, read/change boundaries and durable human feedback. A measurement mechanism and a controller can be fused; do not invent architecture merely to fit names. Its React example is expressly illustrative. Runner commands, credentials, CI templates, recurring execution, PR creation/iteration and push-based dry runs are specialist-only.

The n8n 1.3.0 router and lifecycle preserve planning before construction and distinguish schema validity, actual connections, behavior and publication. Credential labels and secrets are different: discover identities without asking for secret values; ambiguity about the intended account belongs to its owner. Unattended jobs, webhook callers and external services are actors with failure/retry/timeout obligations. Domain adapters own credential binding, error node configuration, execution-model facts and workflow tests. Test tools may execute code, files, data tables or subworkflows; they are not intake fact checks.

## Authority

An evidence source has authority for a claim, time and scope. Code establishes observed current implementation; it does not establish the desired outcome. A maintained owner decision can supersede an old plan for intent while implementation still differs. Preserve that conflict.

The website_reconstruct agent entry point distinguishes installed, exposed, connected, operational and verified. None implies the next. A capability list, empty search, historical receipt or stale graph is insufficient proof of absence or acceptance. Canonical ownership is domain-specific: product, roadmap, evidence packet, runtime registry and verification owners differ. Its HBC scope and gates remain project-local.

Thin CLAUDE adapters add no second authority. Frozen evidence and historical validation receipts remain historical; a prospective correction does not rewrite the original observation. Creative-production specifications and model-selection documents are separate specialist owners, not universal intake requirements.

## Sales

Source-owner discovery selects the smallest useful route: accountable owner, approver, expert, maintained document or public channel. Prefer maintained ownership evidence; recent conversation can corroborate current practice. Split product and process/approval facets when a compound question needs different owners. Organization-specific aliases must come from the user or visible sources.

Customer language needs transcript-like wording and affirmative external-speaker evidence. CRM identity, internal summaries and third-party paraphrases do not prove a customer quotation. Preserve original source, speaker uncertainty, time and context; return an honest evidence gap instead of padding a set. Numeric extraction thresholds and quote quotas remain specialist conventions.

Shared sales dependency guidance allows equivalent supplied material and resolves only evidence categories material to the chosen claim. Provider examples are discovery hints. No source-owner finding authorizes sending messages, assigning work, escalating or modifying records.

## Security

For a consequential security boundary, recover assets, exposure, trusted and attacker-controlled inputs, invariants, exclusions, accepted risks and their owner. A test or code path can reveal intended controls but does not prove that a control works. Material accepted-risk or suppression authority cannot be inferred. Root-to-leaf policy scope is component-specific. Shared intake links the applicable policy and unresolved decision; it does not edit SECURITY.md or run a scanner.

## Scenarios

Bug assessment separates actual symptom, expected behavior, conditions, reproduction evidence, impact and confidence. A suspected cause stays a hypothesis; source paths and reproduction steps are not invented. The source's URL trust policy and .specify assessment/repair artifacts remain specialist-only.

Synthetic-data design starts with failure hypotheses and dimensions, then combinations, then natural-language wording. Proposed combinations need a realism owner. This is an optional way to discover missing representative scenarios, not a mandate to generate an evaluation dataset or ask a fixed number of questions.

## UIUX

Behavior-based actors and jobs capture situation, motivation and outcome. Journey stages expose actions, touchpoints, pain, emotion and opportunities. Assumption-derived personas remain proposed; invented representative quotes are not user evidence.

Goal-based flows include entry, actions, decisions, successful completion, empty/error states and recovery. Component states reveal behavior and accessibility gaps. Forms expose essential inputs, validation and first-success friction. These are conditional lenses, not universal screen requirements.

Research plans ask which decision evidence should support and favor past behavior/current tools over leading future-use questions. Information architecture groups content by users' mental models; card/tree tests remain empirical work. Usability tests and heuristic audits are specialist methods after intake, not proof that an intake scenario is confirmed.

UIUX design generation, token systems, fixed counts, pixel/layout defaults and HTML mockups remain downstream. Repeated affiliate-footer instructions are explicitly excluded from shared intake.

## Figma

The Cursor project-plan source extracts supplied PRD intent before grounding user-named entry points. Its bounded method caps total reads at twenty, follows one in-repository import level, looks for ancestor architecture/ownership documents, and records truncation. Intake may adopt a bounded evidence check without adopting this exact cap or its default test-file exclusions universally.

Its later per-section gap list avoids padded sections and makes missing inputs answerable. The FigJam section catalog and palette/layout/section/nested-section/intro/text/table/columns/sticky/diagram/metadata references remain specialist rendering instructions. They do not replace the canonical Markdown handoff, choose target architecture or authorize board creation.

The historical frontend-app-builder source preserves supplied purpose, audience, workflow, copy and states in a downstream design brief. Image generation, React/Vite defaults, design scoring and browser comparison are specialist-only.

## Analytics

Gather-business-context compares source ownership, freshness, definition, scope and directness. Its transferable stopping condition is sound framing with consequential gaps visible. Its broad analytical acquisition pass is delegated; shared intake keeps fact checks bounded.

Product/business analysis starts with the decision, audience, action, population and comparison. KPI design separates outcome measures from target setting, preserving population, denominator, time window, proxy limits, cadence and guardrails. Do not fabricate a numeric success target.

Create-data-context reuses accepted answers, sequences dependent questions and can group independent ones. It separates applicability from audience and distribution. Expert correction of domain/entity/metric/query/caveat definitions is evidence-specific; unresolved claims stay outside authoritative guidance. Source selection is different from verification or approval. Shared intake retains its own explicit origin/proposal fields even where this source permits style inference in drafts.

Shared analytics dependency policy uses available supplied evidence and checks material access once. Quality criteria preserve denominator, grain, unknown populations, measured-versus-target distinction and recoverable transformations. Inline Sources receipts, reusable context authoring/installation, packaging and scheduled upkeep remain specialist outputs, not extra mandatory intake artifacts.

## Reconstruction

The 2.2.0 source selects the designated version and distinguishes observation, declaration, inference and unknown. Five scope classes separate exact fidelity, adaptable content, replacement, exclusion and allowed uncertainty. Inaccessibility is not exclusion. A correction reopens affected obligations, preserving frozen originals.

Inspection links route/state/environment coverage to evidence and captures conditions and replay/reset steps. Geometry alone cannot prove settled semantic appearance; unavailable probes remain unknown. Capture, asset acquisition and renderer/protocol investigation are domain acquisition methods, not routine intake work.

Integrity, fidelity, adaptation and phase-specific asset/reuse decisions are distinct gates. An intact evidence package does not clear implementation. The shared handoff records the reference authority, intended scope, limits and acquisition route; it does not require the specialist's matrices, screenshot package, asset sidecars or full acceptance plan for every request.

## Fact routes

Qodo codebase wisdom narrows code, history and cross-repository queries, checks its advertised runtime/catalog, cites repository and revision, and distinguishes fetched source from local uncommitted state. Authentication, catalog refresh, setup and maintenance are separate from fact retrieval. Shared/plugin distributions and physical duplicates must retain hashes; identical copies are aliases, not new methods.

Code-review-graph can locate symbols, relationships and flows with minimal context. Verify revision/index freshness and read actual source before relying on an inference. Building an index is a mutation, not a required intake step. Repomix whole-repository packing, Serena setup, Context7 configuration and GBrain memory/database workflows are not automatically launched for a small missing fact. Prefer current accessible sources; record unavailable routes honestly.

REA is relevant when a claim needs a shipped artifact or runtime evidence absent from source. Preserve exact artifact hashes, Evidence IDs, selected scope, partial coverage and limitations. Static/decompiled observations cannot establish execution, policy enforcement or deployed state. Passive capture cannot claim actions or prior activity. Reuse retained views instead of repeating producers. Provider, client approval, PATH and registration failures have different remedies; intake does not install or repair providers.

Native Cline/OpenCode package receipts identify installed versions but do not reveal a readable native interview algorithm. Such behavior remains blocked_unverified, with no invented parity claim.

## Context management

The nested context-engineering collection is primarily agent-system engineering. Structured compression preserves intent, decisions, artifact trails and next actions; filesystem pointers enable targeted recovery. These can support resume without re-asking. Neither requires a new memory service or second mandatory intake artifact.

Fundamentals, degradation diagnosis, caching, memory systems, multi-agent topology, hosted execution, latent KV sharing, self-managed context, tool design, pipeline architecture, BDI ontologies, evaluators and self-improvement loops remain separately classified specialist methods. Their local linked implementation/evidence references are retained with exact source paths and reviewed scope. Volatile benchmark statements are not adopted as verified facts. Digital Brain and literary fine-tuning examples are specialist-only.

## Authoring

The native Codex creator supplies precise discovery boundaries, proportional instructions, progressive disclosure and host invocation metadata. The distinct shared Anthropic creator supplies paired-run, grading, benchmark and human-review mechanics with Claude-specific execution assumptions. Their schemas, grader and analyzer are authoring provenance, not assertions that evaluations ran.

The current plugin-creator 0.1.27 separately supports skills-only/local packages and distinguishes portable Agent Plugins manifests, host metadata and installation. It does not require a new server for instructions alone. Source/ZIP authoring, local installation, account upload and workspace sharing are separate actions. No authoring source or a file on disk proves global discovery or active selection.

Cursor native goal, rule and skill creation remain host-specific lifecycle methods. Their useful scope-recovery principles are accounted for without invoking goal tools, writing global rules or changing specialized factories.
